decisions.reason: The Magento 2 shop template was just launched and fits the firm's template and web service business, so it is likely kept while demand for Magento 2 migrations grows.
Responsive website templates are a low-cost, standard part of a web services portfolio and are cheap to maintain.
Premium support generates recurring revenue from the existing customer base at little extra cost, so dropping it makes little sense.
The version management tool has its own page, which signals investment, though niche developer tools face strong free competition.
The data processing contract generator meets ongoing GDPR compliance demand that began in 2018, though interest may fade after the initial rush.
